clues.text: God told Abraham to take Isaac, his only son, to this land and offer him on a mountain there.
On the third day of the trip from home, Abraham looked up and saw this place far off.
Abraham left his servants and donkey behind, saying he and the boy would go to this place to worship and return.
Abraham named a mountain in this land 'The LORD Will Provide' after offering a ram there instead of his son.
Solomon began building the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on this mount.
The LORD had appeared to King David at this hill in Jerusalem.
David prepared a building site on this mount: the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
